tools.name: search_commands
tools.description: Search CommandVault's library of AI commands (prompts, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md templates, Cursor rules, slash commands, subagents). Returns slugs to pass to get_command.

tools.name: get_command
tools.description: Fetch the full text of a command by slug, with {{variables}} filled from the values you pass. Unfilled variables are listed so you can ask the user for them.

tools.name: list_communities
tools.description: All CommandVault communities with their slug and number of commands.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Curated collections (starter kits such as 'claude-code-starter-kit' or 'cursor-rules-by-framework'). Pass a slug to get the commands in one.

tools.name: trending_commands
tools.description: The commands people are copying, running and voting for most this week.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prompt:one-click-password-reset-182f1360" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
